candidate.title: Microwell- / seq
candidate.scope: The middle row labelled Microwell-seq in the assigned Illumina poster crop, at schematic scope: single cells in agarose microwells, barcoded oligobead capture of poly(A) RNA, and the depicted SMART-Seq2-labelled preparation to a barcoded cDNA library. SMART-Seq2 is an embedded preparation component, not a second target workflow. The partial Seq-Well row above, Nanogrid SNRS row below, and Biotin legend at right are neighbouring context, with no arrows connecting them to this row. No membrane sealing, oligo-lined-well capture, nuclei input or imaging selection is assigned to Microwell-seq. The supplied primary evidence comprises publication metadata and an abstract, not full text; reaction-level claims are limited to the diagram.

states.label: Barcoded cDNA library
features: Final depicted product is a collection of linear cDNA library molecules, downstream of the Adapters/mRNA drawing and SMART-Seq2-labelled enrichment.
The readout carrier is transcript-derived cDNA with barcode information; it represents the captured poly(A) RNA population, rather than every RNA species or the cellular genome.
Cell-label and UMI information are represented by the bead-oligo legend and the final barcoded-library label; the figure does not specify read orientation or a base-level read structure.

operations.mechanism: The poly(A) RNA substrate, Oligo(dT) capture-oligo legend and bead-bound mRNA drawing support oligo(dT)-mediated capture of poly(A) RNA.

The figure supports a single-cell transcriptomic readout but does not define sequencing read positions, complete transcript coverage, or a particular analysis pipeline.
